flights.source: PRIMARY ADS-B POSITION DATA pulled by this repo 24 Aug 2026 from the free ADS-B Exchange monthly globe sample (samples.adsbexchange.com/traces) - source row ADSB-004. The trace self-identifies its own registration and type. Positions resolved to the nearest named field with the CC0 OurAirports gazetteer (ADSB-005).
flights.notes: CLAIM: none - sourced by this repo from primary data, not from any tracker. ARRIVED FROM PARIS-LE BOURGET (LFPB): the trace opens 07:04:30 UTC at 400 ft, 1.21 km from Le Bourget, and ends ON THE GROUND at Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National (KICT), first ground fix 16:33:26 UTC at 0.69 km, last 16:59:21 UTC at 0.89 km - 159 on-ground points. 1,337 trace points. Primary corroboration for the KANSAS leg of the previously unverified clustering claim. COUNTERARGUMENT, AND IT IS A STRONG ONE: Wichita is the American general-aviation manufacturing capital and KICT holds Yingling Aviation, an FAA Part 145 repair station authorised on Dassault Falcon aircraft. SU-BTT is a Falcon 7X. A Falcon at the Falcon shop is the ordinary explanation and it must be stated alongside this row. SAMPLING CAVEAT - PUBLISH THIS EVERY TIME THIS ROW IS CITED: the ADS-B Exchange free sample holds ONE DAY PER MONTH, THE 1ST, AND NOTHING ELSE. This row establishes that the aircraft WAS here on this date. It says NOTHING about how often it came, and it is not a stay of known length - the end_date is the same sampled day because that is the only day the archive holds. COUNTERARGUMENT: a single sampled day at a field with routine transatlantic customs and bizjet maintenance traffic is not by itself evidence of anything, and no Kirk or TPUSA presence is documented at this field on this date.
